title: Turn the store into a class
goal: The store becomes a class with private state, so it can be extended and inspected in tests, without changing what it does.

acceptance_criteria.text: src/todos.mjs exports a class TodoStore with the methods list, get, add, update and remove; its items and id counter are private fields.
createStore() still exists and returns a new TodoStore; every existing behaviour is unchanged, including ids not used up by refused items and callers not being able to change stored items.

context.notes: No behaviour change: the existing tests must pass unchanged. Use #private fields.
